results.error_attribution: ALL 5724 counted errors are a harness defect: SENTINELS s2 lacks key "expect" -> KeyError raised at s["expect"] AFTER a successful HTTP response, caught by generic except and counted as error. Verified post-hoc: live probes of both sentinel patterns return valid responses (SOAK_OK_2026 / {"ok": true}). Effective server failure rate: 0/11449 (100.0% transport success). sentinel_successes 5725/5725 = every s1 request matched exactly.

drift.interpretation: latency drift -11.99% = improvement (warm slot reuse); tps drift -0.02% = none. Contract drift_definition (first-vs-last window means) satisfied; no degradation.

resources.note: RSS constant 1950244 kB across 62 samples; GPU 6761 MiB flat; RSS growth alone never a leak claim (contract) — none observed anyway

hard_stops.check: journalctl -k over soak window: 0 NVRM Xid (one r8169 NIC line contains literal "XID 688" — ethernet driver device ID, not GPU)

lockin_soak: NOT_RUN — LOCKIN (120 min + 3 startup/shutdown cycles + VRAM release checks) is scoped to models advancing toward deployment; Phase 4 DO_NOT_ADVANCE precludes lock-in. Documented as NOT_REACHED, not PASS.
cycle_note: unplanned but real: canonical server restarted 3x during campaign (fa-on restore, MTP swap out, MTP swap back); each reload 0.7-0.8 s warm-cache, VRAM reclaimed cleanly each stop (6767->~300->6761 MiB)
decision: SOAK_PASS_SCREENING (zero real errors, zero drift, zero hard stops)
